Mazindol (BAN, USAN, rINN)  42-548; AN-448; Matsindoli; Mazindolum; SaH-42548. 5-(4- Chlorophenyl)-2,5-dihydro-3H-imidazo[2,1-a]isoindol-5-ol. Мазиндол C16H13ClN2O = 284.7. CAS — 22232-71-9. ATC — A08AA05. ATC Vet — QA08AA05. Pharmacopoeias. In US. USP 31 (Mazindol). A white to off-white crystalline powder, having not more than a faint odour. Insoluble in water; slightly soluble in chloroform and in methyl alcohol. Store in airtight containers. Adverse Effects, Treatment, and Precautions As for Dexamfetamine Sulfate, p.2153. Effects on the testes. Testicular pain developed in 8 men after taking mazindol.1 1. McEwen J, Meyboom RHB. Testicular pain caused by mazindol. BMJ 1983; 287: 1763–4. Interactions As for Dexamfetamine Sulfate, p.2153. Lithium. For a report of mazindol interacting with lithium to cause lithium toxicity, see Central Stimulants, p.405. Pharmacokinetics Mazindol is readily absorbed from the gastrointestinal tract and is excreted in the urine, partly unchanged and partly as metabo- lites.
